environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB target group performs HTTP health checks on /health. Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to instance on port 8080. No additional middleware or filtering layers. Application runs as systemd service under 'appuser' with standard permissions. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db is readable/writable by appuser.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.iam_role: ec2-app-role with SSM and CloudWatch permissions only
